baseline_models.focus_anchor: كان من الجن ففسق عن أمر ربه
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence moves from a concealed kind to an emergence out of lordly command: fisq is materially pictured as a fruit leaving its peel, so rebellion becomes a breach from a containing formative order rather than an isolated refusal.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the covered inside-position from which the breach begins.
A ripe fruit exiting its peel gives fisq a material crossing-out function.
Binding command supplies the normative boundary crossed by that exit.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the breached order formative rather than merely coercive.

changed_reading.after: Iblis ruptured outward from a command that held him within a lordly order of formation and completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أفتتخذونه وذريته أولياء من دوني وهم لكم عدو بئس للظالمين بدلا
baseline_models.mechanism: Taking is deliberate acquisition, wilaya is charge-bearing proximity, min duni installs an other in the relevant place, and badal names replacement. The question therefore exposes a governance substitution: an acknowledged enemy is installed in the near, managing position owed to God.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition and adoption make the patronage a chosen installation.
Taking charge and managing an affair supplies the functional office assigned to the allies.
Otherness supplies the displacement of God by an alternative relation.
Explicit enmity makes the installed patron structurally opposed to its beneficiary.
Putting something in the wrong place diagnoses the patronage as relational misplacement.
One thing standing in another's place names the completed substitution.

changed_reading.before: The verse forbids friendship with Iblis.
changed_reading.after: The verse indicts the deliberate installation of an enemy and his line into God's place of intimate governance and support.

baseline_models.mechanism: Dhurriyya carries minute spreading while wilaya can proceed item after item. The singular rebel is thus extended into a dispersed and successive patronage network rather than remaining one remote antagonist.

activation_trace.role: Minute particles and their spread make the offspring a distributed extension.
One thing following another supplies serial continuity to the patronage network.
Enmity identifies what persists across the distributed succession.
Adoption makes participation in that network an acquired relation, not mere exposure.

changed_reading.before: Iblis has descendants who may also be chosen as allies.
changed_reading.after: A single breach propagates through a dispersed succession that can be repeatedly adopted as near authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brittle growth dispersed by wind gives physical dynamics to the focus's spreading offspring, while sons as worldly adornment contrasted with what endures gives that network a temporal profile: attractive succession that scatters rather than lasts.

activation_trace.role: Scattering grain or flour supplies the focus network's distributive image.
Serial following turns dispersion into successive patronage.
Dry, breakable vegetation supplies a perishable carrier for the network.
Winnowing and windborne flight supply the outward dispersal mechanism.
Moving air supplies the force that distributes the fragments.
Filiation supplies the contextual bridge from sons to the focus's offspring.
Adornment explains the immediate attraction of lineage-based continuity.
Endurance supplies the contrast that reveals the rival succession as nonlasting.

structural_cues: 18:45 moves mixed growth into brittle wind-scattered matter; 18:46 places sons among worldly adornments and contrasts them with what remains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scattering matter, sons, adornment, and endurance; I map their sequence onto dhurriyya as a perishable propagation system. Alternatively, the two context ayat may only contrast worldly goods generally, without specifying the focus's hostile lineage.

changed_reading.before: The offspring form a distributed succession of hostile patrons.
changed_reading.after: That succession behaves like attractive worldly growth: it propagates widely through lineage yet is structurally brittle and nonenduring.

context_deltas.mechanism: The concealed origin and acquired alliance of the focus are set inside an exposure-and-accounting sequence: all are gathered, the record binds every scale of action, and deeds become present. Patronage choice becomes an auditable act that cannot remain under the cover associated with jinn.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies what the surrounding disclosure sequence overturns.
Acquisition identifies patronage as a deed entered into the audit.
Uncovering and appearance supply public exposure.
Driving and gathering everyone to one end supplies the audit assembly.
Binding inscription that establishes judgment supplies the durable ledger.
Exhaustive counting removes any small-scale refuge from the audit.
Presence and witnessed nearness make what was done immediately available.

structural_cues: 18:47 exposes the earth and gathers all; 18:49 records small and large acts and presents what was done.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, exposure, gathering, inscription, counting, and presence; I treat chosen patronage as one of the deeds made present. Alternatively, the audit sequence may frame all action without specially foregrounding alliance.

changed_reading.before: The question challenges a concealed enemy alliance in the present.
changed_reading.after: The question anticipates public disclosure: even a hidden-origin alliance is an acquired, countable relation that will stand present in the ledger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated taking construction creates an asymmetry: humans install Iblis and his offspring as charge-bearing allies, while God explicitly did not take misleaders as an arm that strengthens Him. Wilaya is thereby revised from private affinity to delegated support and operational dependence.

activation_trace.role: Adoption supplies the shared installation operator in the focus question.
Taking charge supplies the office humans assign to the hostile line.
The repeated adoption image makes God's refusal directly comparable to the human choice.
Departure from guidance classifies the rejected personnel by directional failure.
An arm-like helper who strengthens its principal defines the support function God rejects.

structural_cues: 18:50 asks whether humans take the hostile line as awliya; 18:51 answers with God's refusal to take misleaders as an assisting arm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated taking verb and the arm-helper image; I infer that awliya here includes delegated operational support. A live alternative is that 18:51 only denies divine need and does not define every aspect of human wilaya.

changed_reading.before: Humans choose the wrong intimate or guardian.
changed_reading.after: Humans delegate support and practical authority to misguiding agents in a role that God pointedly refuses to assign them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near relation promised by awliya is stress-tested by a call to claimed partners. They give no answering return, and the supposed closeness reverses into separation and an inescapable barrier.

activation_trace.role: Uninterrupted nearness supplies the protection claim put under test.
A raised call initiates the test of relational availability.
Partnership names the claimed reciprocal relation being tested.
Calling and verbal inclination direct the appeal toward the alleged partners.
Answering as returned speech supplies the response that fails to arrive.
Expanded distance reverses the focus's image of proximity.
A barrier between two parties fixes the failed relation spatially.

structural_cues: 18:52 orders a call to the claimed partners, records nonresponse, and places a mawbiq between the two sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proximity, calling, nonresponse, distance, and barrier; I read the later scene as a functional test of the focus's chosen awliya. Alternatively, it may expose false partnership generally rather than only the Iblis relation.

changed_reading.before: The chosen allies are near but hostile.
changed_reading.after: Their promised nearness is counterfeit: when invoked as partners, it produces no response and resolves into a separating barrier.

context_deltas.mechanism: A temporal reversal links Iblis's movement out from command to the criminals' fixed encounter with a destination from which no turning place exists. The initial breach is easy outward motion; its terminal condition is unredirectable arrival.

activation_trace.role: Emergence from a peel supplies the initiating outward breach.
Binding command supplies what the breach leaves.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies terminal arrival.
Turning away from a direction supplies the escape route that cannot be found.

structural_cues: 18:50 marks movement out from command; 18:53 marks expected contact with the fire and the absence of any masrif away from it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exit image, fixed falling, and denied redirection; I supply the causal-temporal arrow from breach to no-exit destination. Alternatively, the two directional constructions may contrast rhetorically without encoding a single trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Fisq describes the past act of leaving command.
changed_reading.after: Fisq opens a trajectory whose apparent freedom to exit terminates in a condition from which no redirection is available.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same acquisition operator that makes an enemy into a wali later makes signs and warnings into mockery. Together with zulm as misplacement and badal as substitution, this exposes a recurring operation: assigning a thing a role contrary to its true function.

activation_trace.role: Adoption supplies the act that assigns the enemy a patronal status.
Putting something in the wrong place diagnoses the status assignment as misplacement.
Replacement supplies the exchange of proper and improper functions.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies the function the disputants try to dislodge.
Repeated adoption marks the same role-assigning operation applied to signs.
A manifest sign supplies the object whose evidentiary role is inverted.
Mockery supplies the false status imposed on signs and warnings.

structural_cues: 18:56 uses ittakhadhu for converting signs and warnings into mockery after describing argument aimed against the stable truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated adoption plus two improper role assignments; I infer a common classificatory operation. Alternatively, ittikhadh may simply govern different objects without making the two errors one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The bad exchange consists in choosing the wrong patron.
changed_reading.after: The patron choice is one instance of a broader inversion technology that reclassifies enemies as protectors and signs as ridicule.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's concealed adversary is followed by an internal apparatus of concealment: neglected prior action, covered hearts, blocked understanding, and weighted hearing. Chosen proximity can therefore be read as installing an occlusive filter inside perception, not only attaching to an external patron.

activation_trace.role: Hiddenness supplies the external adversary's defining spatial quality.
Nearness supplies the route by which the hidden relation may become inwardly operative.
Abandoning and neglecting prior action supplies selective loss from awareness.
The heart supplies the interior site of the occlusive mechanism.
Protective covering supplies the layer that here blocks access.
Understanding supplies the capacity prevented by the covering.
Weight in the ear supplies a second material obstruction to reception.

structural_cues: 18:57 moves from reminder, turning away, and forgotten deeds to coverings over hearts and weight in ears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external hiddenness, chosen nearness, and internal coverings; I infer that patronage can become a perceptual filter. A live alternative is that 18:57 describes an independently imposed judgment rather than an effect or expression of the alliance in 18:50.

changed_reading.before: Iblis is a hidden external enemy whom people wrongly take as near.
changed_reading.after: The hidden enemy's nearness may be enacted internally as a covering system that edits memory, understanding, and hearing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The proposed substitute patronage is tested as refuge under an appointed term. No place of safety exists apart from God, and the closing towns show misplacement reaching destruction at a fixed appointment; badal is therefore a refuge exchange whose failure may be delayed but is scheduled.

activation_trace.role: Love, aid, and alliance supply the protection expected from the substitutes.
An other in God's place supplies the attempted alternative refuge.
Placement in the wrong location supplies the diagnosis carried into the closing example.
Substitution supplies the failed exchange of refuges.
A promise fixed to a time or place supplies the delayed deadline.
The repeated other-than relation directly tests the focus's alternative placement.
Flight to safety and rescue supply the refuge that cannot be found.
Falling into destruction supplies the realized failure of protection.
Repeated misplacement links the closing towns to the focus's wrong relational placement.
A second fixed appointment confirms that delay is scheduling rather than successful refuge.

structural_cues: 18:58 combines a delayed appointment with no refuge apart from God; 18:59 joins wrongdoing, destruction, and another appointed time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitute alliance, denied alternative refuge, wrongdoing, destruction, and appointments; I infer that the closing sequence operationalizes the focus's bad exchange. Alternatively, the towns may exemplify delayed judgment broadly without isolating patronage as their cause.

changed_reading.before: Replacing God with hostile allies is a bad present choice.
changed_reading.after: It is a failed refuge contract: mercy may defer its exposure, but the substitute cannot shelter at the appointed reckoning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the disease-transfer branch under the focus root for enemy, not the ordinary enmity branch. It remains anchored by the exact عدو occurrence and gains coherence from ذرية as minute spread and ولاية as proximity; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for propagated hostility, not as the lexical definition of عدو here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وذريته أولياء من دوني وهم لكم عدو

activation_trace.role: Minute spreading supplies distributed carriers for the hostile relation.
Proximity without an interval supplies the contact condition for transmission.
A disease crossing from one bearer to another supplies an exploratory contagion model of enmity.

changed_reading.before: The enemy and his descendants are multiple hostile persons.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the hostile relation behaves like a transmissible pattern carried by dispersed successors and enabled by intimate proximity.

strongest_changes: 18:51 revises awliya from generic friendship into delegated support: humans take misleaders as strengthening agents whom God refuses as an assisting arm.
18:52 and 18:58 expose counterfeit protection spatially: alleged nearness becomes nonresponse, barrier, and finally no refuge apart from God.
18:56 generalizes the bad exchange into role inversion: the same taking operation installs an enemy as protector and converts signs into mockery.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly turned abstract moral vocabulary into material and operational mechanisms: peel-breach, windborne succession, arm-like support, failed call-and-response, interior covering, and a refuge contract with an appointed failure.
remaining_uncertainties: The command-as-containing-shell reading is an analogy activated by the sole fisq branch, not a claim that amr grammatically means a shell.
The distributed and contagious readings depend on materially distant branches and should remain exploratory where they exceed ordinary lineage and enmity.
The arrow from chosen hidden patronage to the covered heart and weighted ear is reader-supplied; 18:57 may instead describe an independent consequence or judgment.
